column1: # Fixed token spans and numeric/character readers; word/qualifier trie stays dynamic.
# Decimal magnitude is checked against a live pre-multiply UINT64 bound per digit.
# Decimal text keeps its span; hex/octal/character forms carry their value in nv.
# Suffixes are at most three u/U/l/L bytes; octal permits up to 21 digits.
# The existing shared reader accepts bare 0x as zero; this migration preserves it.
# Character escapes retain the original named/octal/hex mapping and byte-value bound.
